user_story: As a logged-in user, I want to log out so that my session is ended securely.

positive.title: Successfully log out from the application
steps: Step 1: User clicks on the log out button.
Step 2: User is redirected to the login page.
positive.expected_result: User session is ended and the login page is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to log out without being logged in
steps: Step 1: User attempts to click on the log out button without being logged in.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the user is not logged in.

edge.title: Log out during a session timeout
steps: Step 2: Wait for session timeout duration.
Step 3: User attempts to click on the log out button.
edge.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page with a message indicating session has expired.
